args: set -euo pipefail; want=$(grep -cE '^## (S|V)-[0-9]+ ' plan/contracts.md); got=$(jq '.slices | length' plan/build.json); test "$got" = "$want"
set -euo pipefail; diff <(jq -r '.selected_requirement_ids[]' plan/build.json | sort) <(grep -oE '\*\*R-[0-9]+\*\*' plan/requirements.md | tr -d '*' | sort)

evidence_required: Compile output JSON for both runs.
The sorted selected_requirement_ids next to the sorted R-ids of plan/requirements.md.
objective: Encode the plan as a typed reveng.graph/1 graph and compile it with the REVENG core so the plan is mechanically validated.

outputs.purpose: Source list with sha256 and recomputation commands; decisions.

risk_controls: The compiler is built and run in a disposable copy; the skill directory is never modified.
Owner documents are referenced by logical uri and sha256 only; their text and paths are not copied into the repository.
Rust by default; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
steps: Build the REVENG core in a disposable copy: cp -R ~/.agents/skills/reveng/core /tmp/reveng-core && cargo build --release --manifest-path /tmp/reveng-core/Cargo.toml.

Author plan/graph.json as reveng.graph/1 (types in ~/.agents/skills/reveng/core/src/model.rs, validation in graph.rs): sources (this repository's plan/commission.md with its sha256, and the two owner decision documents by logical uri owner:<filename> with sha256, read_status full); node types for intent, job, epic, story, requirement, test, slice; edge categories and types including the contract roles (requirement_of_epic, accepted_by_test, story_of_epic, slice_of_story, implements_obligation, verifies_obligation, prerequisite with execution_dependency: true); nodes: the root intent, jobs, the five epics, one story per slice group, every R- requirement with requirement payload (epic, tests, critical, kind, applicability), every T- test, every S-/V- slice with a full Slice payload copied from plan/contracts.md (steps, outputs, checks as command or file_exists primitives, risk controls, rollback, evidence); edges: every relation above, with prerequisite edges exactly equal to each slice's depends_on.
reveng compile plan/graph.json plan/scope.json plan/build then move build.json and contracts/ under plan/; run twice and diff.
plan/sources.md: the source list with hashes and how to recompute them.
